paras: Every week we find things in the sports center, and every week somebody looks for them. Please read this notice before you ask at the desk.
The lost and found box is in the main hall, next to the door. It is open from nine to five, every day.
This week we have three things in the box. A black bag, a blue water bottle and one key. The key was on a chair in room two, under a jacket.
If something is yours, talk to Coach Parker. Her office is between the game room and the kitchen. Don't take things from the box alone.

listenings.text: Hello, this is Coach Parker. I have a message for room two. Somebody left a black bag in the game room this morning. The bag is now in my office. My office is between the game room and the kitchen, and the door is always open. Inside the bag there is a book, a small towel and a phone. The phone is under the towel. Please come before five o'clock, because the office closes at five. Thank you.

Hi, this is Tyler. Listen, I need your help. I can't find my key. I look on the table, and it is not there. I look under the bed, and it is not there. I look in my bag, and it is not there. My mother always says the same thing: the key is never lost, you are. Ha. So please, if you see a small silver key next to the window or on a chair in room two, send me a message. Thank you, my friend.

extra_audio.text: Bruno looks for his bag in the game room. He does not find it on the table. He goes to the lost and found box in the main hall. He finds the bag next to the door. He says thank you to the coach.
